title: Carried Close to His Heart
story:
A family went on a long hike through a beautiful nature trail.

At first, their little daughter happily walked beside her parents.

After a while, she became tired.

Her small legs could go no farther.

Without saying a word, her father gently picked her up and carried her in his arms.

She rested her head against his chest.

She no longer worried about the steep path ahead.

She knew she was safe because her father was carrying her.

Sometimes life's journey leaves us tired and weak.

We may feel that we cannot take another step.

God is our loving Shepherd.

He does not leave the weak behind.

He gathers us in His arms, carries us close to His heart, and gently leads us forward.

His strength becomes our strength when we can no longer walk alone.
life_lesson: God is the Good Shepherd who lovingly carries His children when they are weak and gently leads them each day.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being my loving Shepherd.

When I grow tired or discouraged, help me to rest in Your arms.

Carry me through the seasons when I do not have enough strength on my own.

Teach me to trust Your gentle guidance every day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you been carrying a burden that feels too heavy?

How does knowing that God carries His children encourage you today?

What worry can you place into His loving hands?
verse: He tends His flock like a shepherd: He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart; He gently leads those that have young.
